name: Daily digest (one Telegram summary a day)

knobs.note: BH-3688: 0 stops the lane before any request (summary ` disabled`). Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/daily-digest.notes.log and the default.

BH-3688: the UTC hour from which the lane sends yesterday's digest; an earlier tick exits with no log line and no request. 0 is midnight, not off. Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_SEND_HOUR_UTC:-7}; outside 0..23 is one warn line and the default, never a clamp.

BH-3688: items per list the message shows (the route returns up to 20; the state json keeps them all). Passed to dd_render by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_MAX_ITEMS:-5}; outside 1..20 is one warn line and the default.

BH-3688: the beat line is cut to this many characters with a note naming the full text's file on the hub. Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_TEXT_MAX_CHARS:-3500}; outside 500..3800 is one warn line and the default.

BH-3688: rebuilds of one ticket on the day that count as a loop; sent to the route as loop_min. Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_REBUILD_LOOP_MIN:-2}; outside 2..20 is one warn line and the default.
BH-3688: comma list of the actors whose PR verdicts count as a human's; sent URI-encoded to the route as human. Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_HUMAN_ACTORS:-operator}.

BH-4017: the outcome gap lists a ticket only when its priced build-stage spend is over this many dollars; sent to GET /api/metrics/outcome-gap as min_usd. Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_GAP_MIN_USD:-5}; outside 0..10000 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4017: the outcome gap's grace window: a ticket is listed only when its first priced build spend is older than this many days before the day's end; sent to the route as days. Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_GAP_DAYS:-7}; outside 1..60 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4017: how many days of build spend the outcome gap sums; sent to the route as lookback. Must be greater than DAILY_DIGEST_GAP_DAYS, else bin/daily-digest.sh writes one warn line and uses 7 and 30. Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_GAP_LOOKBACK_DAYS:-30}; outside 2..180 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4017: comma list of the cost_rows stages the outcome gap counts as build spend; sent to the route as stages. Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_GAP_STAGES:-plan,preplan,preplan-files,execute,review,fix}; a value that is not a comma list of [a-z0-9._-] names is one warn line and the default.
BH-3688: 1 lets dd_summary write the one-paragraph summary with a model call; 0 (the default) writes none. Read in bin/lib/daily-digest-summary.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_LLM_SUMMARY:-0}.
BH-3688: USD cap on the one summary call per day. Read in bin/lib/daily-digest-summary.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_LLM_MAX_USD:-0.10}.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/daily-digest.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: a file bin/daily-digest.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.

Test seam gate: bin/daily-digest.sh honours DAILY_DIGEST_NOW and sources DAILY_DIGEST_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.

BH-5003: 1 takes the ledger row daily_digest/<D> with POST /api/ledger/claim before the send, so two hubs ticking at once send one digest; the loser logs ` claimed-elsewhere`. 0 is the rollback: the read dedupe alone, as before. Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_CLAIM:-1}; any other value is one warn line and the default.

BH-5003: seconds after which another hub's `sending` claim on daily_digest/<D> counts as dead and may be taken over (worker clock). 900 is one tick of the 15-minute lane. Read by bin/daily-digest.sh as ${DAILY_DIGEST_CLAIM_STALE_S:-900}; outside 120..86400 is one warn line and the default.
